Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIFT Residential Library Information Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIFT Residential Library Information Assistant post is 30th September 2026. Ensure you complete the application process well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Library Science with at least 60% marks or an equivalent diploma, along with a Bachelor's Degree in any stream with at least 60% marks. Three years of relevant experience in Library Services is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Residential Library Information Assistant position?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 23 years, and the maximum age limit is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the prevailing government norms and regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this contractual role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 45,000 per month for this contractual position at IIFT.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Residential Library Information Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Residential Library Information Assistant in the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT) as per the latest recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for IIFT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will involve a Written Test, followed by a Skill Test, and finally an Interaction round. Candidates need to perform well in all stages to be considered.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for applying to this post?
faq.answer: No, as per the information available, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) to apply for the IIFT Residential Library Information Assistant position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIFT Residential Library Information Assistant Recruitment 2026 is entirely online. Candidates are required to submit their applications through the official website or the provided link.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the IIFT located?
faq.answer: The Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT) is located in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110016. This is the primary location for the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT). The duration of the contract will be specified in the official appointment letter.
